PSYCH 1.sentiment: Reviewers say this is an easy, well-organized intro with engaging lectures, three straightforward papers, and fair exams drawn from slides and lecture. Attend lecture, since some material is not on slides and recordings are unreliable. Extra credit and a dropped test help; a few exam questions are very specific.
